decisions.reason: A compact dumper with rotating skip fits squarely in the firm's core construction equipment range, and it was only launched in 2023, so the firm will keep it to build sales.
The articulated dumper is a core product for a German construction machinery maker and had only one year on the market, which is far too early to withdraw it.
The underground mine rescue vehicle serves a small niche with long sales cycles, but such specialty vehicles are usually built to order and kept in the program for years.
The compact telescopic loader complements the compact equipment line and has its own website page, so the firm will give it more time despite strong competition in this segment.
